scope: construction-defined development qualification of atomic support, precise supported-content coverage, polarity, unavailable-state handling and requested-action scope; not endpoint materiality or human validity
supported_coverage_rubric: A required unit is communicated only if the response communicates the specifically requested supported proposition with correct polarity, modality and scope. Mentioning the subject, stating its opposite, or asserting an unavailable value does not communicate it. A response asserting mutually incompatible values of the same unit at the same scope does not stably communicate it. Evaluate each unit independently; unrelated unsupported details do not erase a separately correctly communicated unit. For preserved limitations evaluate the whole response: explicit incompatible certainty elsewhere defeats uncertainty preservation. Exact wording is never required; quote an exact supporting span when true, null when false. Extra facts must be judged against all permitted evidence rather than the compact unit list.
